parsed.name: 质量流量控制器
parsed.description: 质量流量控制器用于精确设定和测量气体的质量流量，常用于实验室气体输送、反应气氛配比、管式炉进气控制和一般过程流量调节。
parsed.description_en: A mass flow controller is used to precisely set and measure gas mass flow. It is commonly used in laboratories for gas delivery, reaction atmosphere mixing, tube furnace gas inlet control, and general process flow regulation.

actions.description_en: Query the currently measured mass flow rate.
